Available in the CLI with:
```
ollama show gemma4
```

```
    thinking
        levels     false, true
        default    true
```

Available in the API with:
```sh 
curl http://localhost:11434/api/show -d '{"model": "glm-5.3-flash:cloud"}'
```

{
  "thinking": {
    "values": ["low", "high", "max"],
    "default": "max"
  }
}
